reviews.text: Thank you for leaving feedback. Please reach out to us at (619) 768-8278 so we may identify ways to improve your experience.

Stopped by here for the vet to get my dog checked out. Vet tech comes out to a waiting room full of people to ask who was first. I said I was first in line and a man covered in tattoos said he was here for his 3:30 appt and the tech proceeded to help him first. Once she talks to me I remind her I was here before the guy and why she allowed him to cut me. She said “he walked up and I wasn’t going to fight him on it.” Vet tech was too passive and allows anyone to make up their own rules around here. Very unfortunate. PetSMART >>> petco
Every time that I came here our doctor Naola and her crew make us feel home it’s just amazing experience bringing my baby girl here

Dr. Benedek was very nice and professional. Her team is also very caring and helpful. They also very reasonable in pricing. Our new puppy Naomi was very happy with the visit. Would definitely recommend and is my current go-to veterinary clinic.
Dr. B Is the only one we are bringing our 4 fur babies to!

10 stars if I could! I had such a pleasant experience with Dr. Benedek. She is a true animal lover who clearly does this work out of genuine passion. When she first met my dog, Fudge, she actually got down on the floor to examine him, checking his paws, ears, and eyes where he felt most comfortable.

She explains every diagnosis in detail and provides a clear wellness plan (and via email). I especially appreciate that she never "oversells"; she always gives 2–3 different treatment options. Her staff, Leiti and Ivana, are equally impressive—knowledgeable, experienced, and well-trained.

Highlights:
- Amazing service and follow-up
- Deeply compassionate care
- Competitive pricing for the San Diego area
My dogs have recently arrived in San Diego and one had a sore eye. Received vet exam and medication. Great service, friendly people.
Easy to book. Excellent care and concern for my pet.  Reasonable priced.
Convenient & easy-to-use appt scheduling. We needed updated vaccinations last minute and we were able to schedule an appointment online, the night before.

Dr. Benedek and her team are the vet you’ve always hoped for - caring, capable, and considerate of you and your pets needs. They have been absolutely above and beyond supportive and thoughtful in helping us make the best decisions in establishing care for our new rescue. We feel lucky to have found Dr. Benedek’s practice and can’t recommend them enough!

I stumbled here after adopting a cat in this PetSmart,the vet is genuinely the best,you can tell she loves animals and animals love her.shes the pediatrician to my little fur babies.dont mind my cat,she’s mad she had to get a shot 😭
Thanks for your positive review! The whole team here at PetSmart Veterinary Services - San Diego (Sports Arena) strives to provide a positive experience. Wishing you a great day!

I moved back to OB recently, and needed to get Chuy, my 10 y.o. Jack Russell-Chihuahua mix, updated on his vaccinations. Petsmart Vet Services was offering a free exam with shots, so we made an appointment and am super happy with the entire process. Dr. Benedek and her staff were exceptionally nice, gave Chuy a ton of love, took the time to listen/address my specific concerns about lump on Chuy's chest, and provided advice/options without the aggressive up-selling. We weren't billed for Chuy's exam (which took about 25 minutes and spent primarily with Dr. Benedek), so the total cost for Chuy's exam, full round of vaccinations, and 3-months flea meds came out to about $70 less than the cost of just the
vaccinations at a mobile clinic. Based on our experience, Chuy's new vet going forward is Dr. Benedek, and I would highly recommend Petsmart Vet Services to anyone looking for an awesome vet who provides knowledgable, personable care without a huge price tag.
We had a very good experience here with our dog. The doctor was excellent and the staff were very kind and caring. Can highly recommend.
Finally found a vet in San Diego that genuinely cares about my dogs, all the staff there is super friendly and gets on the floor with my boys and kisses them! Made my dogs excited to be there!

Dr.B and her associates are the best,
Dr Benedict is the best vet I have ever had the privilege of knowing and followed her from her last office and I’ve known many….
I have a very ill cat this wonderful  vet found out what is wrong with him & he is still with me since Dr B & staff know how too handle his illness
Kind, considerate ladies, and so obvious how much they love their job & the work they do

Everyone that works here is so kind and helpful! Will definitely recommend my friends and fam to this location. Booking appts (even same day) is so quick and easy and I take my dog to the groomers here as well already once a month so it's super convenient to speak with our vet, if needed!

Always great professional service.
The best!
Dr. B is AMAZING!!!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us this positive review! Have a wonderful day!

My Aussie Cattle Dog has had some sort of allergic reaction causing him to itch and chew on himself incessantly. Had been going to another vet for over a year to get this taken care of but nothing was resolved. Dr. Benedek at PVS gave him a checkup and a good course of action. My dog is doing better but is still on the road to healing. In my case, the cost to get him better is  not cheap (a lot of medications and tests) but it was well worth it. I would definitely and highly recommend PVS Sports Arena to anyone wanting good, sound, veterinary services.

7/1/2025 - Brought my American Bully in for Dr. Benedek to see. She'd been limping and favoring her hind leg. I figured it was arthritis, which was confirmed, but Dr. B also found a CCL tear. Dr. B recommended a surgery center nearest me and a consult is coming up. Thank you, Dr. B.
My Miss Diamond Princess gets her nails,ears,and teeth cleaned for a low $22 service is great and cheap.

I am literally OBSESSED with this vet. Even if you think you mostly like your current vet, you will like this one better. I have never had an issue getting an appointment. I have never had to wait more than 5 minutes for my appointment upon arrival. They were willing to price match the shampoo and ointment that I needed, BUT no need - they had a better price than anywhere else online! Not only that but the overall pricing is EXTREMELY reasonable and frankly the other vets I've been to can't even remotely compete with their bad service and highway robbery. The vet herself has such a great bedside manner, if that's a thing with animals - she has a good sense of humor and doesn't at all make me feel like I'm being annoying with all of my questions even though I know I am  :) The techs are also so lovely and kind and patient. If you "like" your current vet... SWITCH. You will be hard-pressed not to love this one.
Dr Benedek was so amazing with our dog. She is 11.5 and anxious. They got her straight into a room to avoid any extra stress. The vet Techs were so kind. Wishing I could give 10 stars!!

Today I had a wonderful experience, to the time I checked in the clinic. The staff was amazing they taking so good care of my three pets. Ghana my Chow Chow, Molly my havanese, and Nadia my wonderful wheaten terrier. just had so much compassion and love for us and I have already been in a national disaster fire this veterinarian was calm and patient her staff was also the same they care for me and my pets like diamonds. I want to thank you for making our wonderful Saturday beautiful and taking care and getting the care that my dogs needs. God bless you
Thank you so much for the high star-rating!

Dr. Benedek and her team are by far the best I have found since I moved back to San Diego 15 years ago. I have seen too many vets to count and none were as kind, thoughtful, thourough and willing to go above andcbeyond for my 4 dogs. Highly recommend and honestly I don't trust anyone else

Great experience for a first-time wellness checkup.  Appointment was easy to make and there was no waiting to get into a room.  The vet was very friendly and good with the dog.  Excellent experience all around.

Dr. Neola Benedek is the best Veterinarian for our pet baby, Holly Mavis.  She is a very friendly,  accommodating, and caring doctor.   She was also blessed to have a loving and caring staff like Ivana.  I  highly recommend Dr.Benedek to all my family and friends to care for their pets.

Dr Benedek and staff are terrific. Cordial, kind, competent, efficient and with lower costs than other vets I have been too.  Dr B has  been taking care of our golden retriever for close to  2 years. she gets down on the floor and hugs and pets him as if Teddy were her own dog.
Dr. Brendek is amazing. Always patient and kind with our boys. Bug and Boba love her as do we.
Good people
Amazing service, love this location!

The staff was caring and compassionate with my senior cat and their space was clean and comfortable. Dr. Benedek performed a thorough exam making notes and expressing concerns to me as she examined my cat. Labs were recommended for a senior cat and the doctor said she will let me know if any lab results are out of normal range. I appreciated Dr. Benedek reviewing cost of care and treatment with me so no surprises when leaving.

I have been to other vet offices but I feel my cat receives the best compassionate care starting the moment we enter the office until we leave.  I highly recommend this PetSmart Veterinary Services.
Rick

We just moved here and my dog got an upset stomach from stress. They were able to do drop in visits and went out of their way to treat my nervous dog with so much affection and care. I will definitely be coming here from now on.

I've been in San Diego for a very long time and could not find a vet in the area that me and my cats liked.  I was going to Petsmart for cat food and thought I check-out its vet services.  Now Dr Benedek is my go-to vet.  She's the only vet I worked with San Diego who genuinely cares about the health and well-being of cats.  One of my cats had a recent emergency, she recommended an outstanding vet dentist to help.  She has a caring and helpful staff too.  Thanks so much, Dr Benedek, for your care and assistance and your resourcefulness!

Dr. Benedek is a compassionate, dedicated and knowledgeable vet.  I would not consider taking my senior cat anywhere else for care. She has surrounded herself with a friendly and helpful team who will check you in and walk you through the treatment and medication costs, medication details, etc.

Thank you so much for the 5 stars!!

-PetSmart Veterinary Services

I am so pleased I ended up at this clinic. I was traveling in San Diego when my dog needed a vet. I walked to several clinics, but they all said they had no available appointments for the next two weeks. Even when I mentioned it wasn’t an emergency but still very necessary, they couldn’t accommodate us.

On our way back, I spotted PetSmart from a distance and decided to stop at this clinic. They took my dog in immediately and treated him with professionalism and care. The treatment was excellent, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. I truly recommend them!

PetSmart Veterinary Services - San Diego (Sports Arena)

Fast service , very professional and  checked our puppy and diagnosed him. With an ear infection. Love the service . Very friendly staff from the check in to the vet to the check out staff. Highly recommend
Very knowledgeable and helpful.

I was visiting from out of town when my cocker spaniel developed ear infections. I was able to get an appointment right away, and the staff was incredibly kind and professional. They took the time to explain everything to me, and now my pup is on the road to recovery. I truly appreciate their excellent care and customer service. Highly recommend!
Great service got my dog's vaccinations without a hitch. The vet was patient with him and gave him a great thorough exam as well. 👍 …
Dr. Benedek is always patient and calming when a pet is ill. She gives her advice and lets you choose what type of care you wish to go with. She's always knowledgeable but never pushes treatment.

Dr Neola Benedek takes very good care of my dog  she's a very good veterinarian  doctor they have very friendly and helpful staff My dog enjoys coming here I highly recommend Dr Neola Benedek for any of your dogs' needs and health concerns
This is a great veterinary hospital with an awesome team! My pup had multiple procedures here, and they are attentive, communicate often, and are very kind. They are also very affordable!

We were recommended by a friend that this was the best Petsmart location to bring our new puppy. The veterinarian and techs were all so friendly & professional. Our little pup, Dottie loooooved them and even pranced her little self out (after the shots)
Highly recommend based on service, value & location! Looking forward to a long relationship!
Thanks Dr Benedek!
Thank you for the 5 stars, Andy!

I had a fantastic experience at the PetSmart veterinarian services! The vet was incredibly kind, and her supportive staff made both me and my dog feel very welcome. I even bumped into the vet in the lobby, and her friendly energy was so inviting that I decided to register my dog with them as his primary care provider on the spot. I can’t recommend this place enough! As an added bonus, we received some free toys, which was a delightful surprise. Overall, a great experience for both me and my puppy

First and foremost I'd like to thank the staff of PetSmart Veterinary Services. Thank you deeply. They took me in on a Saturday evening when my pet was really sick, vomiting, diarrhea, and it was the worst thing possible it was Parvo. But Dr. Benedeks and the staff's quick treatment and care saved my puppies life. Now Fifi is thriving and doing so much better. So a big thank you again for the wonderful staff at PetSmart Veterinary Services!!!

This place is amazing, the staff is always so thoughtful and caring. Jessica and Armida at the front desk are always so caring to all my pets needs and on top of reminders my pets need. Blair, Ivana, and Gwen are always so sweet and patient with my nervous wreck of a chihuahua and German shepherd. Dr B has been such a knowledgeable doctor to learn from and I have been blessed to have her treat all 3 of my fur babies. I will continue to come here for future exams and care!
They have a great staff and the one working there gwen she is awesome
The vet more than took care of the issues. Thank you

I take my dog to PetSmart Veterinary Services in San Diego (Sports Arena), CA. The staff is friendly and helpful, and Dr. Benedek is caring and thorough while checking my dog. She truly listens to my concerns, and explains clearly what she recommends and what my dog needs. Thank you, Dr. Benedek!
I was happy with how they treated my dog. I just don't understand why they take in another room for tests and shot.
Such a caring and great team! The discounted prices are also a huge plus.
